references.text: Nimrah is mentioned here as part of the land that the tribes of Gad and Reuben wanted to settle in, the same area as Beth-Nimrah in verse 36.
Moses gives permission to build cities for children and enclosures for livestock for small cattle, which is fulfilled in verse 36 with the building of fortified cities and sheepfolds.
This passage describes all the cities that the tribe of Gad built up, including Beth-Nimrah and Beth-Haran in verse 36.
Beth-Haram (a variant of Beth-Haran) and Beth-Nimrah are mentioned as cities in the inheritance portion of the tribe of Gad in the valley.
Beth-Nimrah is mentioned in the prophecy against Moab, showing the place's geographical significance in the region east of the Jordan.
